Agent: Tomorrow works — lovely.Right, Linda, tomorrow at 10 Green Rd — postcode N-E-4-5-A-B. Sound okay?
User: Yes, book it
Agent: I’m booking that in now.
Agent: Brilliant, you’re booked in. Anything else I can help with?
User: No, that's all thanks. Bye!
